constraints: Protected sleep blocks are not moved and still provide at least seven hours each night.

The partner's non-negotiable shifts remove partner availability during the stated solo-care windows.

User-led party handoffs are added because the partner is unavailable, without deleting fixed partner-tagged records.

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This would protect the coffee timing better but requires explicit third-party confirmation.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the calendar owner to update the fixed football records
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This is needed to remove stale fixed entries without violating protected-event rules.

rationale.summary: Selected plan keeps the main child and family commitments, adds the partner's shifts, moves only flexible user events, and uses user-led party handoffs while leaving fixed stale records untouched pending confirmation.
